name: Firecrawl
summary: Web data API for AI agents: search, scrape, crawl, map, parse, interact and monitor the live web, returning LLM-ready markdown or JSON.
description: Managed web data API with an open-source, self-hostable core that turns any URL or query into clean Markdown, structured JSON or screenshots for agents and RAG pipelines. Endpoints cover Search, Scrape, Crawl, Map, Parse (PDF, DOCX), Interact (managed browser actions) and Monitor (change detection with webhook, email or Slack alerts). Python, Node.js, Go and Rust SDKs; a CLI, MCP server and skills connect Claude Code, Cursor and other agents. Free tier, pay-as-you-go credits, AGPL-3.0 core.
contains: endpoints: Search, Scrape, Crawl, Map, Parse, Interact and Monitor
SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go and Rust; CLI via npx firecrawl-cli; MCP server
agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and more
free plan: 500 searches or 1,000 pages per month; paid plans from $16/month
open source under AGPL-3.0 (SDKs MIT); 190k+ GitHub stars; self-hosting documented
benchmarks: 96% coverage, P95 latency 3.4s, up to 93% fewer input tokens
